description:
LibreCuts is a free and open-source video editor for Android focused on simplicity, performance, and privacy. Edit and export watermark free videos entirely on your device.
Note: LibreCuts is currently in beta. You may encounter bugs, instability, or incomplete features as development continues.
Features
• Trim: Remove unwanted parts from the beginning or end of a video.
• Merge: Combine multiple video clips and rearrange them.
• Overlays: Add text, images, GIFs, and video overlays.
• Subtitles: Import .srt subtitle files and reposition captions in the preview.
• Layer Management: Reorder overlay layers.
• Audio: Import audio, boost volume up to 200%, or mute the original audio.
• Crop: Crop videos to custom aspect ratios.
• Transitions: Add smooth transitions between clips.
• Speed: Speed up or slow down videos.
• Adjust & Filters: Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation, and apply filters.
• Reverse: Play videos in reverse.
• Timeline Tools: Snap clips, duplicate overlays, and create freeze frames.
• Hardware Acceleration: Export videos faster using supported hardware encoders.
